# Chakra UI v3 + Kineto (v0.11.0)

붙이는 방식: **props-passthrough** — Chakra v3 components are Ark UI + style props; unknown `data-kt-*` props reach the DOM. Mount `<KinetoProvider>` once. For `asChild` compositions put the attribute on the element that renders.

```jsx
import { Card, Heading } from '@chakra-ui/react';

<Card.Root data-kt-card-glow="edge">…</Card.Root>
<Heading size="4xl" data-kt-text-reveal="stream">Ready to ship</Heading>
```

## 설치

```bash
npm install @dong-gri/kineto
```

React 앱은 루트 레이아웃에 프로바이더를 한 번 두면 됩니다(클라이언트 컴포넌트). shadcn 레지스트리의 `@kineto/provider`가 아래 컴포넌트를 설치해 주며, 다른 React 앱에서도 같은 코드를 그대로 쓸 수 있습니다.

```tsx
'use client';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import Kineto from '@dong-gri/kineto';
import '@dong-gri/kineto/style.css';

export function KinetoProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handle = Kineto.observe();
    return () => handle.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return <>{children}</>;
}
```

## 이 라이브러리가 이미 제공하는 것

`accordion`, `tabs`, `tooltip`, `toaster`, `dialog`, `drawer`, `skeleton`, `progress`, `switch`, `menu` — 동작·접근성은 라이브러리에 맡기고 Kineto는 모션만 더합니다.

## 같이 쓰면 안 되는 조합

- Chakra `Presence`/`Dialog` animate their positioner via `data-state` keyframes; do not add a Kineto reveal to the same node.

## 의도별 레시피

### 히어로 헤드라인 등장 (`hero-headline`)

- `textReveal` · `stream` — Characters resolve left to right — the default look for launch pages.

  ```jsx

  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('textReveal', { speed: 30, preset: "stream" });
  ```

- `textReveal` · `hangul` — Korean copy: assembles jamo into syllables instead of flashing random glyphs.

### 이미지 로딩 효과·플레이스홀더 (`image-loading`)

- `lazy` · `skeleton` — Shimmer placeholder that resolves into the image.

  ```jsx
  <img data-kt-lazy="skeleton" data-kt-skeleton-variant="shimmer" data-src="/photo.webp" alt="" />
  ```

- `lazy` · `blur-up` — Blurred preview sharpening — content sites.

  ```jsx
  <img data-kt-lazy="blur-up" data-src="/photo.webp" alt="" />
  ```

- `lazy` · `pixelate` — Stepped pixel mosaic settling into the image — editorial/product shots.

  ```jsx
  <img data-kt-lazy="pixelate" data-src="/photo.webp" alt="" />
  ```

> Library skeletons are layout boxes for text; Kineto's lazy skeleton sits on the `<img>` and hands off to the real picture with no layout shift.

### 이미지·영상 그래픽 질감 (`media-texture`)

- `stylize` · `dither` — Retro two-tone dither kept on the image (brand/showcase).

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-cell-size="8" data-kt-dither-type="4x4">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { cellSize: 8, ditherType: "4x4", preset: "dither" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — Dither that shrinks into the original photo once it scrolls into view.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-mode="reveal" data-kt-trigger="view" data-kt-cell-size="10">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { mode: "reveal", trigger: "view", cellSize: 10, preset: "dither" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — The dither to reach for on a photograph: `noise` has no repeating tile, so a fine cell reads as texture instead of as an 8x8 weave. Use this before reaching for a smaller cell size.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-dither-type="noise" data-kt-cell-size="3" data-kt-contrast="1.4">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { ditherType: "noise", cellSize: 3, contrast: 1.4, preset: "dither" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — Clustered-dot print screen: ink grows as one blob per cell, the way newsprint and risograph do. Keep the cell small (1-3px) or the blobs read as a checkerboard.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-dither-type="cluster" data-kt-cell-size="2" data-kt-contrast="1.5">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { ditherType: "cluster", cellSize: 2, contrast: 1.5, preset: "dither" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `halftone` — Newspaper halftone. The angle is the part that matters: a screen square to the frame reads as a table, and tilting it 15-45 degrees is what makes it read as print.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="halftone" data-kt-halftone-shape="dot" data-kt-halftone-angle="45" data-kt-cell-size="6" data-kt-contrast="1.35">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { halftoneShape: "dot", halftoneAngle: 45, cellSize: 6, contrast: 1.35, preset: "halftone" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `halftone` — Open-ring screen: thin outlines in the highlights that close up in the shadows. A graphic, editorial texture rather than a photographic one.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="halftone" data-kt-halftone-shape="ring" data-kt-halftone-angle="30" data-kt-cell-size="8">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { halftoneShape: "ring", halftoneAngle: 30, cellSize: 8, preset: "halftone" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — A dither that stays on the image while the grain crawls — alive without moving the layout.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-contrast="1.4" data-kt-cell-size="3" data-kt-motion="drift">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { contrast: 1.4, cellSize: 3, motion: "drift", preset: "dither" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `ascii` — ASCII that keeps re-typing itself: the living-terminal look for a hero or an about page.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="ascii" data-kt-motion="shuffle" data-kt-motion-amount="0.35">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { motion: "shuffle", motionAmount: 0.35, preset: "ascii" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `dither` — The picture sharpens only under the pointer — an interaction, not just a filter.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="dither" data-kt-cell-size="8" data-kt-pointer="lens" data-kt-pointer-cell-size="2">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { cellSize: 8, pointer: "lens", pointerCellSize: 2, preset: "dither" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `halftone` — Permanent halftone print look on an image or video.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="halftone">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { preset: "halftone" });
  ```

- `stylize` · `ascii` — ASCII-art filter for terminal/tech aesthetics.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-stylize="ascii">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('stylize', { preset: "ascii" });
  ```

- `glitch` · `image` — Chromatic-aberration glitch bursts over a photo — louder than a texture.

  ```jsx
  <h2 data-kt-glitch="image">Text</h2>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('glitch', { preset: "image" });
  ```

> Raise `contrast` (1.3-1.6) before anything else: a photograph sits in the middle of the tonal range and dithers to grey mush at the default 1.

> Pick `ditherType` by the subject, not by taste: `noise` for a photograph (no repeating tile, so a fine cell reads as texture), `cluster` or a rotated `halftone` for a print look, `8x8`/`16x16` for a graphic two-tone treatment, and `floyd-steinberg`/`atkinson` when the original colours have to survive.

> Stylize redraws the pixels; it does not load anything. Pair it with the `image-loading` intent when the picture also needs lazy loading — both attributes can sit on one <img>.

> A source the canvas cannot read back (cross-origin without CORS) simply shows unstyled, so the texture is never a hard dependency.

> `motion` (drift/shuffle/scan/flow/pulse) keeps the look alive on a still picture and `pointer` (lens/spotlight/ripple) makes it react; both redraw every frame, so lower `renderFps` when several are on one screen.

### 다이얼로그·모달 등장/퇴장 모션 (`dialog-enter-exit`)

**Dialog**가 열림·닫힘과 포커스를 소유합니다. Kineto는 그 안의 콘텐츠에만 모션을 더합니다.

- `presence` — Host-owned enter/leave: `<KinetoPresence>` (React) or `useKinetoTransition` (Vue) around the dialog body.

  ```jsx
  import { states } from '@dong-gri/kineto';
  import { KinetoPresence } from '@dong-gri/kineto/react';
  const panel = states({ hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 12 }, visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } });
  <KinetoPresence present={open} options={{ enter: { state: panel, name: 'visible' }, exit: { state: panel, name: 'hidden' }, mode: 'wait' }}>…</KinetoPresence>
  ```

- `reveal` · `zoom-in` — One-shot entrance for the modal body when the library only fades the overlay.

  ```jsx
  <section data-kt-reveal="zoom-in" data-kt-duration="0.35">…</section>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('reveal', { duration: 0.35, preset: "zoom-in" });
  ```

- `pageReveal` · `iris` — Full-screen takeover transitions (showcase/event sites).

  ```jsx
  <body data-kt-page-reveal="iris">…</body>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('pageReveal', { preset: "iris" });
  ```

> The library owns open/close and focus; Kineto animates the content inside.

### 페이지 전환·첫 진입 리빌 (`page-transition`)

- `pageReveal` · `curtain` — First-paint curtain that opens once the page is ready.

  ```jsx
  <body data-kt-page-reveal="curtain" data-kt-color="#0a0908">…</body>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('pageReveal', { color: "#0a0908", preset: "curtain" });
  ```

- `pageTransition` · `same-origin` — Multi-page sites: fetch same-origin pages and animate between them.

  ```jsx
  <body data-kt-page-transition data-kt-container="main">…</body>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('pageTransition', { container: "main", effect: "same-origin" });
  ```

- `loader` · `bar` — Full-screen loader bound to real load progress.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-loader="bar" data-kt-source="window">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('loader', { source: "window", preset: "bar" });
  ```

> SPA routers (Next.js, Nuxt, React Router) own navigation — use `pageReveal` on first paint and presence for route content, never `pageTransition`.

### 인라인 로딩 인디케이터·실제 진행률 (`loading-state`)

이 라이브러리의 **Spinner**를 먼저 씁니다. Kineto 레시피는 그 컴포넌트를 쓰지 않는 페이지에서만 적용합니다.

- `loadingIndicator` · `spinner` — Inline spinner (with the library's spinner absent or when a determinate source exists).

  ```jsx
  <span data-kt-loading-indicator="spinner">Text</span>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('loadingIndicator', { preset: "spinner" });
  ```

- `loadingIndicator` · `terminal` — Terminal-style frames for developer/AI products.

  ```jsx
  <span data-kt-loading-indicator="terminal">Text</span>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('loadingIndicator', { preset: "terminal" });
  ```

- `loader` · `circular` — Full-screen loader bound to fetch/promise/resource progress.

  ```jsx
  <div data-kt-loader="circular" data-kt-source="fetch">…</div>
  // or, when you need the instance:
  const { ref } = useKineto('loader', { source: "fetch", preset: "circular" });
  ```

> Use the library spinner for indeterminate waits; use Kineto `loader` when you can bind a real progress source (`trackPromise`, `trackFetch`, resources).
